captureCompatibility.reason: archive-selected-v02 only admits program.ssa/s/o and successful original writers; close CLI cannot reopen sealed roots. A root-reviewed exact-leaf adapter can reuse close.capsule and unchanged archive-v02 verification without reopening lifecycle.
captureCompatibility.sourceManifestHandling: Archive selected source manifests byte-exactly. Keep terminal API reader receipts and compact proposal pins hot. Define the archive receipt protected metadata honestly; if a selected manifest is automatically protected through writersClosed, do not suppress the verifier refusal.

dependencyAudit.rootSeedRule: Every dispatch-/plan-/borrow- root, every abi-*03 root, vertical-base-api02/source02 and store-native-candidate-source02; every direct file is protected, then existing Phase173 paths in bounded JSON are followed transitively.
dependencyAudit.limits: Conservative bounded JSON closure and current method literals, not a prediction of future requests. Root must recheck active inputs immediately before capture.

protected: all current ABI03, dispatch, checked-plan/replay, borrow/AST/digest artifacts and transitive inputs
store-api05/source05 and store-verifier-controls01 values discovered as transitive dependencies
all binaries, retained/source IR, profiles/runtime objects, qualified chains, native oracle source roots and every unselected file
shared lock, guard/retention state, original API/control reports and logs
limitations: Additional raw allocation, not net recovery. Proposal02 is separate; do not count applied files twice.
Review only: no adapter implementation, capsule, verified prune plan, archive or deletion.
Source snapshots are complete metadata-only outputs. Terminal guarded API readers establish finished use; no guarded source writer is fabricated. Failed acquisition stays labeled failed.
Historical retired API reacquisition/replay needs exact restoration of selected source/API/value leaves.
